text:
**Accuracy:** The facts match the source:
- reopening date and duration
- the $3.2 million cost and joint council/state funding
- all four improvements, including the solar share of "about a third"
- the enrolment date, unchanged prices and their amounts
- opening hours and opening-day details

"Prices unchanged for 2026-27" is a fair compression of "same as before the closure for the rest of the 2026-27 season."

One small loose point is "All programs … resume on opening day." The source names only lap swimming, aqua aerobics and learn-to-swim. It is not wrong, but it reaches slightly beyond the source.

**Coverage:** A manager gets what they need: when it reopens, what it cost and who paid, what changed, what runs and when, prices, hours and opening-day plans. The detail about replacing the leaking 50-year-old pool briefly explains why the work was needed. Leaving out the quotes from the mayor and swimmer is the right call.

**Concision:** It is about 115 words, so under the limit. The bold headings and bullets make it fast to scan, and there is no padding.

It is a strong, accurate and well-organised summary with one slight overgeneralisation.

Score: 9
